newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford '97 estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford '97 estimates cut.

text.p: --Salomon Brothers analyst Jack Kirnan trimmed his 1997 full-year estimate for Ford Motor Co because of an expected slowdown in Ford's fast-growing Financial Services Group. Kirnan estimates the company will earn $4.00 a share, instead of his previous forecast of $4.25.

--Financial Services results for 1997 are expected to be flat against 1996 results, Kirnan said. He noted pre-tax fourth quarter earnings for the group were $859 million, down 6.3 percent from the year-ago level, largely due to weaker results at its Ford Credit unit.
--Kirnan said he continues to rate Ford's stock a "buy," noting its strong dividend yield and underlying asset value.
